$comment: Outputs of triage-agent.js recorded from production runs. The same ticket was triaged on each run listed; runs disagree where the prompt leaves the decision to the model.

tickets.raw:
From: sam@smallshop.example
Subject: Double charge

I was charged twice this month, please refund one of them.

runs.summary: Customer was charged twice and wants one charge refunded.
Requests a refund for a duplicate monthly charge.

tickets.raw:
From: ops@acme.example
Subject: Refund for unused seats

We removed 40 seats last week; please refund the charge for them.

runs.summary: Enterprise customer wants a refund for 40 removed seats.
Asks for a refund on seats removed last week.

tickets.raw:
From: ops@acme.example
